title: ‘Queer Eye’s’ life coach Karamo Brown launches Kē, a wellness app featuring his AI digital clone
description: Karamo Brown, famous for his pep talks on Netflix’s “Queer Eye,” has jumped into the wellness and AI space with his new app, Kē. After spending a year and a half focusing on his own journey—from fitness and nutrition to meditation, sobriety, relationships, and personal growth—Brown wants to help others do the same.  Kē offers […]
summary_cn: 《粉雄救兵》生活教练Karamo Brown推出健康应用Kē，核心特色是其AI数字克隆功能。该应用整合健身、营养、冥想、人际关系等模块，用户可与AI版Brown进行个性化互动，获得定制化建议。技术层面采用数字孪生与自然语言处理，模拟Brown的沟通风格与专业知识。商业上借助名人IP降低用户获取成本，切入AI健康市场规模约500亿美元。产品创新在于将真人经验数字化，提供24/7情感支持与行为指导，但需平衡AI真实感与隐私边界。
